_purpose: Regression coverage for the free-form SVG composition path that the rewritten SKILL.md prose recommends for the fireworks renderer. The fixture is a pre-authored SVG that mimics the kind of output an LLM would produce when following fireworks-tech-graph's SKILL.md verbatim (multi-line text via <tspan>, sublabels, lane background rects, semantic arrow styles). The runner copies this fixture into the case output dir and asserts the downstream pipeline (rsvg-convert validation, PNG export) handles it. This is a proxy: it tests the coordinator's assumption that a free-form SVG produced by the renderer's own composition path can be ingested + validated + exported without our skill needing to constrain the input shape.
